description: Time series of rank-tracking metrics for ONE tracked query across a date window, bucketed by granularity (daily, weekly or monthly). The tracked query fixes the engine and country, so those are not parameters. Use search_tracked_queries to find a trackedQueryId. Optionally includes per-competitor lines. Prefer weekly or monthly for long windows. Dates must fall within the data retention window. Answers questions like "show the share-of-voice and position history of this one query over the last N months".

competitorIds.description: UUIDs of competitors to add as extra series; competitor UUIDs are listed by get_available_filters (competitors[].id)

trackedQueryId.description: a tracked query UUID from search_tracked_queries (items[].id)

name: get_tracked_query_time_series
title: Single tracked-query time series
